parameters.help_en:
The ID of the backup plan.

If your instance is an RDS for MySQL instance, automatically add the RDS instance to DBS to obtain the backup plan ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/193091.html
parameters.help_zh:
备份计划ID。
若您的实例为RDS MySQL，请通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/193091.html功能，将RDS自动添加至DBS中，即可获取备份计划ID
parameters.name: backup_plan_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup set. If you specify this parameter, the operation returns information about the snapshots of only this backup set. If you do not specify this parameter, the operation returns information about the snapshots of all backup sets that are created for the backup plan
parameters.help_zh: 备份集ID。若您传入该参数，仅返回该备份集的快照信息；若不传入该参数，将返回该备份计划的所有快照信息
parameters.name: backup_set_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

30 (default)

50

100
parameters.help_zh:
每页的记录数。取值如下：
30（默认）
50
100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be greater than 0 and cannot exceed the maximum value of the integer data type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，大于0且不超过Integer的最大值，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

Data.description_en:
The data returned. The value of this parameter is a JSON string. The JSON string contains the following fields:

backupSetTime: The point in time of the snapshot. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format and is displayed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

backupSetId: The ID of the backup set.

backupSetType: The type of the snapshot. Valid values: Full (full backup) and Inc (incremental backup).

backupPlanId: The ID of the backup plan
Data.description_zh:
参数说明：
backupSetTime：快照时间点，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。
backupSetId：备份集ID。
backupSetType：快照类型，Full表示全量备份集快照、Inc表示增量备份快照。
backupPlanId：备份计划ID
